description: One call before an agent pays: the payee facts, the agent's own context from our ledger (what it paid in the period, how often, whether and when it first paid this payee, how many new payees today), the out-of-character score of this payment as the agent's next, and a decision under a policy written in the AP2 mandate vocabulary (allowed_payees, amount_range, budget {max, period: daily|rolling_24h|rolling_7d}, agent_recurrence, execution_date) plus ours: new_payee {max, window_hours, max_new_per_day, step_up_ratio, step_up_days}, refuse_conditions {fact: block|warn|log|ignore} and signal {v2: {notable, major}}. Anything the evaluator does not understand fails closed. Named policies: log-only (default), balanced, recommended, recommended-v3, strict (their measured cost on 500 real agents is in the policy document). The answer is block / warn / log / allow with every reason, and is recorded in log-only mode: we never block anything; your client decides, and decides its own fail mode when we are unreachable.

agent.description: The paying agent: token id, act_8453_N, slug or bound wallet

policy.description: Or your own policy object in the AP2 vocabulary; unknown keys fail closed

name: gate_check
title: Can this agent pay this address, now, this much? (free, log-only)
